package.name: easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_simple_api_deployment
package.description: The "simple API" mirror of easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_deployment: the exact same two-robot scenario (real EasyNav navigation on both robots, robot_1 also carrying a fake perception capability, robot_2 a fake manipulation one, same Gazebo world/map, same launch/config/rviz shape), but robot_node.cpp is written against easyfleet_core::Deployment's simpler API instead of the sibling package's hand-rolled lifecycle dance -- see that package's own robot_node.cpp for the one being mirrored, and refactor.md at the workspace root for the design history. The two packages are meant to be interchangeable at the launch level: point a launch file at this package instead and everything else behaves the same. The mission script (main_easynav_collaboration.cpp) is still a straight copy of the sibling package's own (old API) for now -- see that file's own header comment.
